title: Ethology of Latent Spaces
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The analysis centered on how different models perceive and classify artworks based on political, aesthetic, and objective visual properties, revealing significant divergences in their 'algorithmic sensitivity'.

measurement_description: The paper did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its focus was on demonstrating algorithmic sensitivity and emergent biases in vision-language models concerning political, cultural, aesthetic, and compositional categories using a corpus of artworks.
